about.title: The art of enhancing your natural beauty
about.body: At Hera The Beauty Studio we believe every look has its own story. We're a team of professionals specialised in eye aesthetics, brow care and hand & foot treatments. Our studio, located in the heart of A Coruña, is a space designed to make you feel cared for, comfortable and completely yourself.

services.manicure.sub.russianNoPolish.de: Cuticle work with an electric file and a deep cleanse, no polish.
services.manicure.sub.express.name: Express manicure
services.manicure.sub.express.desc: Short on time? Our express manicure is for you. Choose classic or semi-permanent polish and in just 30 minutes we file, polish and moisturise.
services.manicure.sub.hydratingRemoval.d: Want to give your nails a break from semi-permanent polish? Taking a break from polish doesn't mean forgetting about your nails. We safely remove the polish and give you a full manicure with hydration and care for your natural nails.
More than just polishing your nails, it's a moment for you. Our full manicure leaves your nails flawless, your cuticles perfect and your hands soft, finishing with a hydration treatment you'll love.
services.manicure.sub.russianLevelling.d: Where precision meets glamour: precise cuticle removal with an electric file, levelling with builder gel for a smooth, resistant base, and a high-shine, clean, flawless finish. Ideal for natural, brittle or ridged nails.
services.manicure.sub.polygelFullSet.des: Extension and reinforcement with a natural, ultra-resistant finish. Ideal for fragile, bitten or slow-growing nails. A light, flexible finish that lasts 3 to 4 weeks, with levelling and a custom shape.
services.manicure.sub.polygelFill.name: Polygel nail fill
services.manicure.sub.polygelFill.desc: Renew your set without removing it completely. Correction of natural growth with polygel, restoring shape, structure and levelling, including semi-permanent polish. Ideal 2 to 4 weeks after the first treatment.
services.manicure.sub.glazeDecoration.de: A pearly veil that turns your nails into jewels: a pearl or mirror finish, elegant and minimalist, ideal for a clean, glam, modern look.
services.manicure.sub.frenchDecoration.d: Minimalism with attitude, glamour without overdoing it. Decoration on one nail per hand (glitter, lines or minimalist details) or a classic or coloured French on all nails. Ideal for elegant, understated manicures.
services.manicure.sub.fiveColorDecoratio: Five tones, five ways to stand out: each nail in a different colour, in harmony or contrast, or a multi-tone French. The elegance of French tips with a unique twist.
services.manicure.sub.babyBoomerDecorati: Soft elegance in an ombré finish: professional colour blending from base to tip, with an airy effect and subtle transitions. Ideal for weddings, events or understated, stylish looks. Classic, delicate and always on trend.
services.manicure.sub.nailArtSimple.name: Simple nail art (both hands)
services.manicure.sub.nailArtSimple.desc: Delicate, minimalist designs that enhance your manicure: fine lines, dots, stickers, airbrush, foil or subtle details. Ideal for those looking for an artistic touch without excess, with an optimised working time that doesn't skimp on detail.
services.manicure.sub.nailArtElaborate.d: Custom artistic designs with maximum precision and detail: freehand art, airbrush, stamping, foil, embossing, gems or combined techniques, adapted to each nail type and style. Ideal for events, photos, or simply showing off art in every gesture.
services.manicure.sub.polygelRepair.name: Polygel nail repair
services.manicure.sub.polygelRepair.desc: Reconstruction of a broken or damaged nail using polygel, matching the shape, length and thickness to the rest of the nails. A subtle reinforcement to leave it strong and ready to show off.
services.manicure.sub.semiPermanentRepai: Did a nail chip after your manicure? Come in for a free repair within 24-48h of the service. After that, we offer individual repairs at a very accessible price, without redoing the whole set.
services.manicure.sub.veilTherapy15.name: Hand or foot veil-therapy massage (15 min)
services.manicure.sub.veilTherapy15.desc: The express ritual you need: a total relaxation veil-therapy massage on hands or feet, with aroma and hydration. In just 15 minutes, get the disconnection you're after. Combine it with other treatments.
services.manicure.sub.veilTherapy25.name: Hand or foot veil-therapy massage (25 min)
services.manicure.sub.veilTherapy25.desc: A moment for yourself in just 25 minutes? A veil-therapy massage made with oils and butters with hydrating, nourishing ingredients, leaving skin with a soft texture.

Complete care for feet that want to shine: nail cutting and filing, cuticle removal, gentle exfoliation and heel polishing, deep hydration, and classic or semi-permanent polish.

services.pedicure.sub.express.desc: Your feet ready in no time and with plenty of style: nail cutting and filing, light cuticle removal, basic hydration, and your choice of classic or semi-permanent polish.

Brow threading

Full brow design and threading

Brow tint

Hybrid brow tint
services.brows.sub.organicBrow.name: Organic Brow (brow reconstruction treatment)
services.brows.sub.organicBrow.desc: A brow reconstruction and care treatment that strengthens, nourishes and disciplines the hair from within. Its formula with botanical active ingredients improves brow health, giving a more defined, flexible and natural finish. Ideal for weak, dehydrated brows or those lacking density. The result is stronger, healthier-looking, visibly more beautiful brows, with a soft laminated effect.
services.brows.sub.browThreading.name: Brow threading
services.brows.sub.browTweezing.name: Brow tweezing
services.brows.sub.fullDesignThreading.d: Your brows shouldn't look like anyone else's. That's why we design your ideal shape based on your face structure and thread them for unique precision.
services.brows.sub.lamination.name: Brow lamination
services.brows.sub.lamination.desc: More defined, groomed brows with a natural lifted effect. A smoothing technique that restructures the hair to keep it in the desired direction. Ideal for unruly brows, with low volume or uneven growth.
services.brows.sub.tint.name: Brow tint
services.brows.sub.tint.desc: Professional tint application adapted to your skin tone and hair colour. Intensifies the brow's natural shape without needing makeup, with results visible for up to 2 weeks depending on skin type. Can be combined with threading or lamination.
services.brows.sub.hennaTint.name: Henna brow tint
services.brows.sub.hennaTint.desc: A 100% plant-based product that colours both the hair and the skin, creating a fuller, more defined brow effect.
services.brows.sub.hybridTint.name: Hybrid brow tint
services.brows.sub.hybridTint.desc: A combination of traditional brow tint with henna tint.
services.lashLifting.title: Lash lifting
services.lashLifting.desc: We curl and enhance your natural lashes with a long-lasting effect, no extensions needed. Includes nourishment and tint for a more intense look.
services.lashLifting.subsections:
Classic lash lift (includes tint)
Flash lift
services.lashLifting.sub.classic.name: Classic lash lift (includes tint)
services.lashLifting.sub.classic.desc: Naturally enhance your gaze with a lash lift that curves, lengthens and defines your lashes. In just one hour, get a more open, fresh look with no need for mascara. Includes tinting of the upper lashes.
services.lashLifting.sub.flash.name: Flash lift
services.lashLifting.sub.flash.desc: Short on time? No problem: enjoy the same results as the classic lift in just 30 minutes. Ideal if you're in a hurry but don't want to give up a striking look.

services.lips.sub.plumpMyLips.name: Plump My Lips
services.lips.sub.plumpMyLips.desc: Dry or dull lips? It's not filler, it's a treat: Plump My Lips hydrates from within, repairs and enhances your lips with no needles and no pain, for a natural effect.
services.micropigmentation.title: Micropigmentation
services.micropigmentation.desc: Semi-permanent technique to define brows or other areas with a natural, long-lasting result.
services.pressotherapy.title: Pressotherapy
services.pressotherapy.desc: Drainage treatment using controlled pressure that improves circulation and reduces the feeling of tired legs.
services.pressotherapy.subsections:
10-session pressotherapy pack
5-session pressotherapy pack
Ballancer Pressotherapy
services.pressotherapy.sub.pack10.name: 10-session pressotherapy pack
services.pressotherapy.sub.pack10.desc: Transform your body in 10 steps. Our pressotherapy pack stimulates drainage, reduces inflammation and improves skin texture with no effort. With continuous sessions, the results are real.
services.pressotherapy.sub.pack5.name: 5-session pressotherapy pack
services.pressotherapy.sub.pack5.desc: Combine it with other treatments: pressotherapy isn't just aesthetic, it's health. The 5-session pack is your new wellness ritual, ideal for eliminating toxins, reducing fluid retention, improving circulation and slightly smoothing cellulite.
services.pressotherapy.sub.ballancer.des: Your body is asking for a break: this session, more than an aesthetic treatment, is about health. Feel total relief, wellbeing and relaxation with our Ballancer pressotherapy. While your body relaxes, you can combine it with other treatments.
